hook.text: Procter & Gamble decides how much Tide to ship to Walmart. The supplier manages the retailer's stock.

buildup.text: In VMI, the supplier monitors the buyer's inventory levels and replenishes stock without purchase orders.

discovery.text: It reduces stockouts, cuts ordering overhead, and lets suppliers plan production more efficiently.

twist.text: VMI requires deep trust and data sharing. If the supplier overstocks to boost their sales, it backfires.

climax.text: Successful VMI partnerships like Walmart-P&G have reduced out-of-stocks by over 30%.

punchline.text: Let the supplier manage your stock. If you trust them enough.

quiz.question: Who decides replenishment quantities in VMI?
